Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game then. India start their title defense with a clinical win. They now take on, Japan, the land of the rising son who already have one point under their belt due to their washout game against New Zealand. India's game against Japan starts on 21st January at 1000 local (0800 GMT). We will love your company for that game. Till then, goodbye and take care.

Indian skipper, Priyam Garg, says that he is really happy with his side's performance. Tells that they could've added more runs on the board but feels that they lost set batsmen in the middle overs. Finishes off by saying that he will give India 9/10 for their performance in this game.

Sri Lanka, skipper, Nipun Dananjaya, says that India were excellent in all the three departments and deserved the win. Tells that they have an excellent side and they will look to correct their mistakes from this game and come back stronger.
SIDDHESH VEER IS NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH for his all-round performance. He says that he is really happy from his performance. Tells that he enjoys batting more than bowling.

Indian bowling was excellent throughout the game. The pacers bowled with hostility and troubled the opposition batters. Tyagi, Mishra and Singh were excellent throughout the game. Siddhesh Veer and Ravi Bishnoi were superb with their spin bowling too. As they did not allow the Lankans to score freely. Bishnoi struck twice in two balls while Veer and Singh returned with two wickets to their name to seal the game for India.

So, a comfortable victory for India. The Lankans never looked to be in command of the run chase. India struck early but Ravindu Rasantha and Kamil Mishara presented some fight during their 87-run stand. However, they hardly showed any urgency during the stand. Apart from these two, Nipun Dananjaya, the Lankan skipper played 59-run inning off 56 balls, he could never got going either. Once India broke the second wicket partnership, none of Sri Lanka batters could present any fight. They tumbled from 180/4 to 207/10.

OUT! RUN OUT! Game over! Full ball outside off, Madushanka looks to drive but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards square leg. It rolls towards square leg. Pathirana from the non-striker's end looks for a single, Madushanka takes off too but the single is not on. Saxena picks the ball and fires the throw at the non-striker's end. He hits the target and Dilshan is short. INDIA WIN BY 90 RUNS.
FOUR! Slapped through the covers! A full ball outside off, Madushanka slams it through the covers and it races to the fence.
Huge appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire. A full ball again, it is outside off again, Pathirana looks to drive but misses again.

Short and wide again, Mishara finds the point fielder with his cut.
FOUR! Driven nicely! A shortish length ball outside off, Mishara slaps it through the covers and bags another boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

In the air... but lands safely! A bouncer outside off, Paranavithana looks to pull but the ball takes the outside edge and goes over gully. Tilak Verms from point runs forward and tries to catch it with a dive but he cannot get his hands to it. Another couple for Paranavithana but he would've had his heart in his mouth.
Full and around off, it is pushed down the ground. The mid off fielder chases the ball but before he can pick it up, a couple taken.
Outside off, Paranavithana lets it be.

Huge appeal but maybe there was an inside edge and height seemed to be an issue too. A length ball on middle, it moves just a hint as Navod looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Indians appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Short of a length ball around off, Navod taps it to point.
Full and outside off again, Kamil this time pushes it towards covers.
Mishra bowls another wide fuller ball, Kamil goes chasing after it but cannot make any connection.

FOUR! Slapped! First boundary of the run chase. Mishra bowls it short and outside off, Mishara reaches out and slaps it through the covers. There is no protection in the deep and it races to the fence.
WIDE! A back of a length ball which goes way over the ducking batsman. Called wide for height.
Another ball which is outside off, Kamil lets it go to the keeper. He thinks that the umpire might call it wide but it was just inside the tramline.
In the channel outside off, it is left alone.

Good start from Mishra too. It is a full ball which is shaped away from the left-hander. Paranavithana looks to squeeze it away but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes towards the leg side. A single taken.
Sushant Mishra to bowl from the other end.
Bowls a fuller one on off, it is pushed back to the bowler. Quality first over from Tyagi.
Another mild appeal from the bowler but this is once again down the leg side and pitched outside leg too. Navod looks to flick but misses. It rolls towards short fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
Mishara is off the mark now! A slightly shorter length ball on off, Misahra taps it through point for a single.
Another pacy ball on the pads, Mishara look to flick but misses. Tyagi makes a loud appeal this time but it is going down the leg side again.

Length ball on the hips this time, it is 144.5kph. Navod does well it tuck it towards fine leg for a single to get the scoreboard ticking. There was a stifled appeal from the bowler but it was clearly down the leg side.
Tyagi starts with a slightly shorter ball outside off, it is left alone.

We are back for the run chase. The Indian players walk out to the middle and are followed by the Lankan openers, Navod Paranavithana and Kamil Mishara. Kartik Tyagi will start the proceedings for the Indians with the ball. Here we go...
